title: release --patch aborts at its canon step with the version stamped and uncommitted, so the re-run it asks for fails its own clean-tree gate, and the message denies a --skip-settings v3 has
body:
`bin/devbin build release --patch` can abort at its canon step after it has stamped the version, leaving VERSION and the declared sidecars modified and uncommitted, so the re-run the message asks for fails the script's own first gate ("working tree is not clean -- commit or stash first"). The same message says v3 has no `--skip-settings`, which it has. Raised by vc on the v3.0.3 cut, 2026-09-14.

Read against `bin/.devbin/cmd/build.d/release` at v3.0.3:
- `bin/devbin version set $TARGET` writes VERSION and the sidecars (about line 749), then `intent agents sync` and `intent claude upgrade --apply` run. If the canon regeneration writes anything outside the sidecar list, the script aborts (about line 986) with "Nothing has been committed. Bring the files above into line with canon in their own commit, then re-run". Nothing is committed, but the stamps are in the tree, and the clean-tree gate (about line 461) refuses the re-run until they are reverted by hand. The message does not say so.
- The abort text says "v3 has no --skip-settings to stop it". The script's own comment above the call (about line 938) says v3's `intent claude upgrade` takes `--apply`, `--daemon`, `--force` and `--skip-settings`, and the CLI has it.

Fix: check for canon spill BEFORE stamping (run the canon regeneration against the unstamped tree, or dry-run it), so an abort leaves the tree as it found it; failing that, the abort reverts the stamps it made, or names the exact files to restore. And the message states what `--skip-settings` does and does not spare rather than that it does not exist.


CLOSED 2026-09-14 (dc): the canon spill is checked BEFORE the version is stamped. A dry run of `intent claude upgrade` lists what canon would write, and a tracked path outside the sidecar list aborts the cut with nothing stamped. The late abort, still reachable for a spill the dry run cannot see, now names the exact `git checkout -- <sidecars>` restore and says what `--skip-settings` does and does not spare. Judged in a clone of main (scratchpad batch/judge-0386-c.txt, 16:23:36Z): a tracked canon file that `claude upgrade` must write back was deleted, and the early check aborted before VERSION was touched and named the file.
